subject: POC final readout & exec decision - Acme Health
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + next steps from today's discovery call

Hi Priya (and Jamie),

Thanks again for the time today — great discussion on where Acme Health wants to pilot Redwood for clinical summarization and discharge note generation. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Success criteria (initial):
  - 90% of generated summaries rated >= 4/5 by clinical reviewers on relevance and accuracy
  - Average generation latency < 1.5s per summary for batch of 5 concurrent requests
  - No PHI exfiltration; all inference stays in your VPC for the Private deployment trial

- Evaluation plan:
  - 2-week POC with 500 clinical notes from three pilot hospitals
  - Redwood provides a lightweight SDK and example ingestion lambda
  - Weekly checkpoints (Wed mornings) to review sample outputs and telemetry

- Ownership & roles:
  - Acme: Priya (POC lead), Jamie (clinical reviewer), Oliver (IT/procurement)
  - Redwood: Marcus (AE, trial owner), Marissa (CS/onsite support), Dev (SRE for VPC setup)

- Timeline (proposed):
  - Week 0 (this week): Kickoff, data access scoped, & VPC peering sign-off
  - Week 1-2: Ingest & run trial; run weekly sample reviews
  - Week 3: Final readout + exec decision (Go/No-Go) — recommend scheduling a 45-min exec review meeting

I've attached a draft success criteria spreadsheet and a proposed timeline (poc_timeline_v3.pdf) to this thread. Can you confirm owners and whether the proposed weeks work for your team? Also please let me know the right contact for procurement so we can surface contract timing if the readout is a Go.

Thanks,
Marcus

--
Marcus Lin

Thanks Marcus — this looks good and aligned with what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side:

- Owners: Confirming Priya (POC lead), Jamie (clinical reviewer). Oliver will coordinate with our InfoSec/procurement on VPC/networking and contract timing.
- Success criteria: We can confirm the accuracy target internally but would like to add: no hallucinated PHI fields (we'll provide a checklist).
- Data access: Oliver will share a secure S3 bucket and a short inventory by EOD Monday. We will redact direct identifiers per our standard process but keep structured fields needed for evaluation.

Proposed readout timing: Jun 24 or Jun 25 for the final exec review. We prefer Jun 25 (Thursday) 1:00-1:45pm PT if that works for your execs. Can you hold that?

Also tagging our procurement lead (oliver.nguyen@acmehealth.com) on the thread so he can share any standard PO/contract terms we need to prep.

Priya/Team,

Appreciate the quick confirmation. Attached is an updated POC plan (acme_poc_success_criteria.xlsx) with your additional note about PHI checks incorporated. Key updates below: 

- Data & security: Dev will send a VPC peering checklist + Handover doc. We will run the trial in your VPC using a private deployment node; no customer data leaves your network.
- Evaluation cadence: Weekly sample review every Wed 10:30am PT (first review Wed Jun 24) — updated in the attached timeline.
- Final readout: Proposed Thu Jun 25, 1:00-1:45pm PT. Agenda: 1) POC results & metrics, 2) Sample outputs & clinical feedback, 3) Exec Q&A and decision (Go/No-Go), 4) Next contract steps (if Go).
- Decision process: We recommend your clinical director + CIO on the call for the Go/No-Go. If Go, we will surface a preliminary SOW and contract timeline immediately and connect procurement to our sales ops.

Could you confirm the attendee list for the final readout and whether Jun 25 13:00 PT is locked? If yes, Marissa will prepare the short slide deck and I'll circulate the final invite and slides by Tue EOD.

Thanks,
Marcus
